title: 2k/3 Neverblade - The game that never ends.

posts.author: kaarlof
posts.body:
​
SYNOPSIS
Spoiler
Neverblade
is a surreal RPG that never ends.
In
Neverblade
, you play as Cain, an orphan who has to live alone with his brother in the medieval town of Orchad.
Through a very sudden and grim sequence of events, Cain ends up dying.
But it is not over for Cain, because he has been given the punishment of Immortality.  As such, Cain will be reborn a century later every time he dies.
But do not worry, dear player of this game, as this fact will not make my game unfathonably easy.
Every time Cain dies prematurely due to your own lack of skill, i shall bring him back to before he died. That way, you may enjoy this game just like any normal game.
But every time Cain dies due to inevitable circumstances, the game will continue.
In
Neverblade
, you, dear player, may choose to force Cain to initiate a conversation with any enemy he encounters. The adversaries will not spare you, but they may give helpful information. This will ensure that every single enemy you encounter has a personality of their own and is a character just like any other.
At night, Cain has a strange dream where a strange creature asks him to find ten pieces of the Neverblade. As such, you explore his dreams every night to create the enigmatic weapon which shall end all suffering in the world.
Right now, only the demo which has the first Act of this game is released. In it, Cain and his brother, Abel, as well as his friends, Sarah and Michael fight against an army of red-eyed animals that have taken over the areas around the town of Orchad. As the days pass, they figure out more and more disturbing secrets about their hometown. At the end, you shall find out what led to Cain's death and what horrible action was done by him to get the punishment of Immortality.
Demo length: ~3-4 hours
Controls:  Arrow keys to move, Z to interact/advance dialogue/confirm, X to open menu/cancel
This game contains dark themes, so it is not intended for very young audiences. It is still a pixelated game, so there are no realistic depictions of blood or anything.
Neverblade is connected in some ways to my previous game, Spider Cave.
https://kaarlof.itch.io/spidercave
I would still recommend playing Neverblade first.
Game made in RPG Maker 2000
I wonder how much suffering it takes until Cain finally falls to despair. How many cycles of death and rebirth it takes until he truly becomes insane. Because...
THIS GAME NEVER ENDS.

posts.body:
Neverblade Act 2 - Devlog
#1
Hey everybody!
I've been working on Act 2 of Neverblade, and i want to share my progress.
Work has been kind of slow, as starting a whole new giant act of a game has felt a bit overwhelming with so much stuff to do, but i have gotten a decent amount of stuff done.
I have made most of the  spritework in the central area of the act (kind of like Orchad in the first act of the game but way bigger) already, as well as a big chunk on the soundtrack (even songs that play much later on).
As for actual gameplay, only about the first ~10 minutes of are actually playable. Though some enemies are already made, i just haven't put them in the game yet.
A lot of the dialogue of the central area is also done.
I feel like as i'm making this act of the game, i realize that i'm getting way better at many things, especially making music and spritework, so i kind of fear that there will be a bit of a quality difference between Act 1 and Act 2, but i don't want to set expectations that i can't reach.
Bye!
